name: xLayout help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's xLayout plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: xLayout settings
entries.text: How Molly holds its apps: IDE mode and its pane layout and limit, the three toolbars and where they sit, and which apps have joined Molly's menus.

entries.title: IDE mode
entries.text: On: apps open as tabs in panes you drag by their tab, resize with the bars between them and dock on any edge. Off: one app at a time, filling the page.

entries.title: Pane layout
entries.text: The layout IDE mode starts with. Choose layout shows each one with a preview first.

entries.title: Pane limit
entries.text: The most panes on screen at once. A tab dropped past the limit joins a pane as a tab instead of opening a new one.

entries.title: Choose layout
entries.text: Opens the layout picker: tap a layout to see its preview and which apps land where, then Apply layout.

entries.title: Customize
entries.text: Opens the Toolbar designer for this toolbar: pick its items from every app and screen, and where each one opens. Needs the Toolbar designer plugin.

entries.title: Where
entries.text: The edge of the app area this toolbar sits on: top, bottom, left or right.

entries.title: Apply layout
entries.text: Turns IDE mode on, opens enough apps to fill the panes and lays them out as previewed.

entries.title: IDE mode
entries.text: Switches between one app at a time and apps in panes.

entries.title: Pane layout
entries.text: Pick one of the preset pane layouts, with a preview before it applies.

entries.title: Open in a pane
entries.text: Opens this app in a new pane beside the current one (IDE mode). Past the pane limit it joins the current pane as a tab.

entries.title: Open in a floating window
entries.text: Opens this app in a window of its own that you can move, resize and dock back.

entries.title: Customize toolbar
entries.text: Opens the Toolbar designer for the toolbar you right-clicked.

steps.say: Molly shows AmberX, axHub and the Console as one app: one menu bar, one navigation and one right-click menu hold all of theirs.
Turn on IDE mode to put apps side by side in panes, then pick a layout with Choose layout.
